injuries.name: Jeffers/Basallo
injuries.note: 10-Day-IL: Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Friday that Basallo (shoulder) will resume hitting within the next couple days, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Luis Arraez
injuries.note: Day-To-Day: Arraez went 4-for-5 with two RBI, a run scored and a stolen base in Wednesday's 16-3 win over the Brewers.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: 60-Day-IL: Ragans underwent UCL repair surgery on his left elbow Wednesday, Anne Rogers of MLB.com reports.
